deadline.value: Deadline for new applications to the Faculty Board. The earliest after 26 October 2026 is 10 November 2026; later rounds on the same page are 24 November 2026, 5 January 2027 and 2 February 2027.
deadline.quote: Deadline new applications + submission changes + Submission examination committee in Plato ... 10 November 2026

also.quote: Check the deadline to submit documents for the Faculty Board.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Your supervisor registers you as a new PhD candidate in Oasis, and the faculty then decides on the application.
supervisor.quote: Your supervisor will register you as a new PhD candidate via oasis.ugent.be.

also.quote: Before starting the application procedure, candidates must have a prospective supervisor at Ghent University.

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed. Candidates must find it themselves, through a scholarship they apply for or a staff position on a project.
funding.quote: Some funding agencies offer possibilities for pre- or postdoctoral researchers to apply for a scholarship or fellowship at Ghent University on an individual basis.

also.quote: Search for funding for your PhD.

entry_route.value: Open to master's holders. A four-year degree can qualify only if Ghent judges it equivalent, assessed case by case.
entry_route.quote: The doctoral programme is open to holders of a master’s degree or a degree corresponding to at least four years of study that is considered equivalent by Ghent University.

also.quote: Open to holders of a master degree or a degree of minimum four years of study considered equivalent by the university

notes: Bioscience Engineering runs its own Faculty Board deadlines, so its deadline differs from the other faculties. The faculty's doctorate title is listed as Doctor of Bioscience Engineering: Environmental Sciences and Technology.
name: Doctor of Bioscience Engineering: Environmental Sciences and Technology
